text:
eli: Heads-up: Customer on Private (vpc-deploy) seeing collector upload fail with 403 after redaction step. Error in our logs: "signed-manifest-validation failed: invalid-signature". Request IDs: req_6a3f2b and req_6a3f2c. Need repro steps and debug bundle.

maria: Sorry to hear that. Do we have the collector version and the collector.log tail? Also which upload method (presign -> PUT to S3 or sftp fallback)?

eli: Collector v0.9.4, using presign to their S3. Their platform team says presign URL returns 403 when collector attempts final PUT. Preflight (HEAD) works. We saw mismatch on manifest checksum just before upload.

cheng: Can we get the exact failing PUT curl from the collector? Ask them to run a curl reproducer from a machine in the same network and include full headers. Example curl we usually ask for: 
```
curl -v -X PUT "<presigned-url>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
  --data-binary @bundle.tar.gz
```
Include --trace-ascii output if possible.

maria: Also need collector debug bundle. Ask them to run: 
```
collector-debug --gather --redact --out /tmp/debugbundle.tar.gz
```
and then attempt upload with DEBUG=1 to capture the handshake: 
```
DEBUG=collector:upload collector --upload /tmp/debugbundle.tar.gz
```
This will print the presign flow and any signature calculation we do.

eli: I already asked for those but their infra team is slow. In the meantime can we try to reproduce from our side? Cheng, can you try generating a signed manifest locally with a minor tamper to see if we get the same error path?

cheng: Yep. Reproduced locally by changing manifest checksum after signing. Our runtime returns: 
```
ERROR upload: signed-manifest-validation failed: checksum mismatch (expected 7f3a1d, got 9b2e4c)
HTTP PUT -> 403 from S3
```
That suggests collector is altering bytes between signing and upload or the presign is for different content-length/headers.

maria: Another angle: their KMS could be re-wrapping the presign with additional constraints (x-amz-content-sha256 or required content-type). Ask them to paste the full presign URL (obfuscate query param values) so we can compare to what collector uses.

eli: I'll push a short checklist to the customer: collector debug bundle, curl -v reproducer, presign URL (obfuscated), collector.log tail (/var/log/redwood/collector.log last 200 lines), timestamped system time (date -u), and whether they use VPC endpoints for S3.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-14290 created and linked to this thread. ETA: 24h for initial customer response. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: If they can't upload debug bundle, offer SFTP fallback and give them an on-prem upload token window. Also ask them to try forcing no chunked transfer: add `--header "Expect:"` to curl to avoid 100-continue.

cheng: Good call. Also ask them to run a small binary-diff after redaction step: 
```
sha256sum bundle-pre-redact.tar.gz bundle-post-redact.tar.gz
```
We want to see if redaction alters sizes or metadata unexpectedly. If checksum changes but manifest wasn't updated, that's the root.

eli: Next steps for us: if we reproduce locally with tampered manifest, prepare a hotfix branch to validate manifest earlier and surface clearer error to customer. For now we need the customer's debug bundle. I've DM'd the customer contact and escalated to solutions-eng.

maria: I'll prepare a short repro checklist we can paste to them (curl example, debug bundle command, log paths, S3 presign snippet, sha256 commands, and an SFTP fallback endpoint). Will post here when ready.

eli: Thanks — please ping if customer posts the presign URL or traces. I'll keep monitoring the ticket. :white_check_mark:
